import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from unittest.mock import patch

import openai_client

source = open(\"openai_client.py\", encoding=\"utf-8\").read()
compile(source, \"openai_client.py\", \"exec\")

class FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, body):
        self._body = body.encode(\"utf-8\")
    def read(self):
        return self._body
    def __enter__(self):
        return self
    def __exit__(self, *_):
        return False

request_holder = {}

def fake_urlopen(request, timeout):
    request_holder[\"request\"] = request
    request_holder[\"timeout\"] = timeout
    assert request.method == \"POST\"
    assert request.get_full_url() == \"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\"
    assert request.headers.get(\"Content-type\") == \"application/json\"
    assert request.headers.get(\"Authorization\") == \"Bearer test-key\"
    assert timeout == 12.0
    body = json.loads(request.data.decode(\"utf-8\"))
    assert body == {
        \"model\": \"test-model\",
        \"input\": \"private prompt\",
        \"store\": False,
        \"temperature\": 0.2,
    }
    return FakeResponse(json.dumps({
        \"output\": [{
            \"type\": \"message\",
            \"content\": [{\"type\": \"output_text\", \"text\": \"mocked answer\"}],
        }]
    }))

with patch.dict(\"os.environ\", {\"OPENAI_API_KEY\": \"test-key\"}):
    client = openai_client.OpenAIClient(timeout=12.0, model=\"test-model\")
    assert \"test-key\" not in repr(client)
    with patch.object(urllib.request, \"urlopen\", fake_urlopen):
        answer = client.send_text(\"private prompt\", temperature=0.2)
assert answer == \"mocked answer\"

def fake_urlopen_error(*_args, **_kwargs):
    error_body = json.dumps({\"error\": {\"message\": \"mocked API error\"}}).encode()
    raise urllib.error.HTTPError(
        \"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\", 401, \"Unauthorized\", {}, error_body
    )

with patch.dict(\"os.environ\", {\"OPENAI_API_KEY\": \"test-key\"}):
    client = openai_client.OpenAIClient(model=\"test-model\")
    with patch.object(urllib.request, \"urlopen\", fake_urlopen_error):
        try:
            client.create_response(\"private prompt\")
        except openai_client.OpenAIResponseError as error:
            assert error.status == 401
            assert str(error) == \"mocked API error\"
            assert \"private prompt\" not in str(error)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(\"expected OpenAIResponseError\")

print(\"offline checks passed\")
